product_one_liner.value: voize is an AI voice assistant that turns nurses’ and caregivers’ spoken notes into structured documentation and transfers it into existing care-record systems.

pricing_page.notes: Public pricing and licensing page explains facility-based licensing by number of people receiving care; numeric prices are not published.

employee_band.notes: Public profiles report approximately 192 employees; this is a reported headcount, not an audited payroll count.

eng_blog.notes: The engineering blog includes Erik Ziegler’s PyTorch Lite Multiplatform post and Reuben Morais’s OpenTelemetry/Prometheus infrastructure post.

public_docs.notes: Public help center contains multiple collections, including a hospital collection with 23 articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Live posting: Senior ML Engineer – NLP.

model_provider.value: Anthropic Claude; proprietary on-device AI models
model_provider.notes: The NLP engineering posting explicitly states that Claude is used through voize’s inference service alongside open and on-device models; the funding announcement describes proprietary models developed in-house.

compliance_certs.notes: These are publicly stated compliance claims, not independent certification attestations: the German site claims GDPR compliance, and the US FAQ claims HIPAA compliance and BAAs. No first-party evidence of completed SOC 2, ISO 27001 or PCI DSS certification was established.

last_funding.notes: Announced November 17, 2025; led by Balderton Capital. This predates the November 9, 2026 reference date.

raised_18mo.notes: The November 17, 2025 Series A falls within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Live posting: Sales Development Representative (m/f/d) – SaaS.

launched_6mo.notes: September 22, 2026 announcement: voize and Dedalus launched voice-based AI documentation integrated into the ORBIS hospital information system.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Luis Semprun announced joining as VP Engineering on September 8, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The SDR posting explicitly identifies HubSpot among the tools used.
